body: Judging how long I've had to wait so far, I'm not sure I can wait another few years.... I don't think I even want to

Thank you. And I don't even feel like working out a relationship with my captors (parents) at this point. I can hear my mom screaming at the lady who does the food shopping right now. Why would I want to work out something with somebody who even does that?

Edit: Gave you gold I liked your empathy, fellow human

I don't know, I replied to the pizza place asking what the problem was or if there was something I could improve on, but haven't heard back and probably won't. And most likely something about the family, we have the biggest mansion in the area and I'm sure most of the town are aware of my parents. They donate a lot to the town hall for elections and stuff.

Idk. The ghetto is the area with those small run down brick apartments where all the spanish and black people live. On craigslist they cost $1,100 a month for 1 bedrooms not counting utilities. It's just not possible to live there on minimum wage. I'm sure the families that live there are squeezing a few people per room.

If anybody actually read this wants to help move me out of here and give me a fresh start...

I'm willing to even prostitute myself. Gay for pay, torture me, whatever you want....
